title: LogicTracer next-capture profile (.ltprofile)
description: A saved plan, not a recording. Channels and trigger use the CLI syntax; quantities retain their display units. The active device determines which plans can be captured.

channels.description: Ordered, one-based channels with optional aliases.

samples.description: Samples in the first window (pre + post).

trigger.description: Immediate, edge, or a contiguous pattern of levels.
